04.09.2023 WPPIL No. 99 of 2023 
Sri Vipin Sanghi, C.J.
Sri Alok Kumar Verma, J.
1. Mr. Pradeep Upreti, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. C.S. Rawat, learned Chief Standing Counsel 
with Mr. B.S. Parihar, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State. 
3. Mr. D.S. Patni, learned Senior Counsel assisted 
by Mr. B.S. Bisht, learned counsel for respondent no.3.
4. Mr. Rawat states that he has received 
instructions that a sum of Rs.3.00 lakh has been 
sanctioned for construction of road for the first phase. 
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that 
the said sanction had been granted in the year 2022 
itself. He submits that no action has been taken 
thereafter. 
6. We direct the respondents to positively file the 
latest status report within two weeks. They should also 
indicate within how much time the actual construction 
of the road shall be undertaken, and be completed. 
7. List on 19.12.2023.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.) 
 04.09.2023 04.09.2023 
NISHANT

12.11.2024 WPPIL No. 99 of 2023 
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J. 
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
1. Mr. Pradeep Upreti, learned counsel for 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. Gajendra Tripathi, learned Standing Counsel 
for the State of Uttarakhand. 
3. On the oral prayer made by learned counsel for 
petitioner, he is permitted to implead ‘Divisional 
Forest Officer, Nainital Forest Division, Nainital’ and 
‘Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, 
Government of India, through its Secretary’ as 
respondent Nos. 4 & 5 in the petition. 
4. Let amended memo of parties be filed by 
22.11.2024. 
5. The newly impleaded respondents shall be served 
through respective their Standing Counsel appearing
for the Divisional Forest Officer and the Ministry of 
Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government 
of India.  6. List this matter on 10.12.2024. 
7. In the meantime, learned Standing Counsel for 
the newly impleaded respondent shall get instructions 
in the matter. 
 (Vivek Bharti Sharma, J) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, ACJ)
 12.11.2024 12.11.2024

--Petitioner
 Versus

Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.

1. None is present for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. Gajendra Tripathi, learned Standing
Counsel for the State. 
3. Mr. D.S. Patni, learned Senior Counsel, 
assisted by Mr. B.S. Bisht, learned counsel for 
respondent no.3. 
4. Mr. Piyush Garg, learned Senior Counsel 
assisted by Mr. Ravi Shankar Kandpal, learned 
counsel for the applicant in impleadment applicaton 
(IA No. 3 of 2026).
5. Learned State Counsel submits that proposal 
for diversion of forest land for road construction was 
submitted in the Regional Office of Ministry of 
Environment, Forest and Climate Change, 
Government of India, on 11.01.2024. However, 
progress made in the matter thereafter is not 
known. 
6. Having regard to the public interest involved in 
the matter, we post this case on 03.11.2026. 
7. Divisional Forest Officer, Nainital, Forest 
Division shall appear in person before this Court 
along with entire record of the case. 
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.)
